summary: Wall Street fell about 1% (Nasdaq -1.1%) on AI-trade unwinding and growing Fed rate-hike bets that lifted the dollar to a 19-month high and sank gold; Nvidia then beat and raised after the close, shares up after hours.
events_next_24h: Thu 6:00am USD FOMC minutes (27-28 Oct meeting)
tier1_next_14d: FOMC minutes (27-28 Oct meeting) · Thu 19 Nov 6:00am
US PCE and personal income (Oct) + Q3 GDP 2nd estimate · Thu 26 Nov 12:30am

NQ.why: AI-led selloff and Fed hike bets are bearish, but Nvidia's beat-and-raise lifted shares after hours and funds are crowded long (98th pct).
NQ.risk: A clean break either way after the Nvidia call and Thursday's FOMC minutes.

ES.why: S&P fell ~1% on hike bets and AI worries, but Nvidia's beat gives a relief catalyst; signals conflict before FOMC minutes.
ES.risk: Hawkish minutes or Nvidia gains fading would tilt it bearish.

YM.why: Dow led Tuesday's drop on rate-hike fears; no clear catalyst for the next session beyond the Nvidia read-through.
YM.risk: Hawkish FOMC minutes would tip it bearish.

RTY.why: Small caps are hurt by higher-rate bets, but a broad Nvidia relief bounce could lift them; not enough evidence for a lean.
RTY.risk: Minutes showing hike support would turn it bearish.

NKD.why: Nikkei is down 9% in 20 days on chip selling and a firmer yen, but Nvidia's beat should help Tokyo chip names at the open.
NKD.risk: Yen jump on intervention or semis failing to bounce would turn it bearish.

6E.why: Dollar hit a 19-month high on Fed hike bets and risk-off flows weighed on the euro; macro and price agree.
6E.risk: Dovish FOMC minutes or a risk-on rebound would weaken the dollar.

6J.why: Intervention risk near 160 and BoJ December hike talk support the yen, but widening Fed hike bets push the other way.
6J.risk: Actual Japan intervention would send 6J sharply higher.

6B.why: Broad dollar strength and risk-off weighed on sterling; UK CPI at 6pm Sydney adds two-way risk.
6B.risk: A hot UK CPI that lifts BoE hike bets would support sterling.

6A.why: Aussie dipped as the dollar rallied on Fed hike bets and stocks sold off; it trades as a risk-sensitive currency.
6A.risk: An Nvidia-led risk-on rebound in Asia would lift the Aussie.

ZN.why: Markets are pricing Fed hikes and officials flag inflation going the wrong way, though yields steadied after retail sales.
ZN.risk: Risk-off flight to safety or dovish minutes would lift bonds.

GC.why: Gold opened at its lowest since Sep 2025 as the dollar and hike bets rose; commercials are the most long in 3 years, a contrarian warning.
GC.risk: Dollar reversal or a geopolitical scare could spark a short-covering bounce.

CL.why: Supply-surplus outlook is pushing oil lower, but tanker attacks near Hormuz and funds near crowded short (10th pct) argue against chasing it.
CL.risk: A major Gulf supply disruption would send crude sharply higher.
